surface_name: Node.js version for builds and functions
title: New Vercel deployments fail after October 1, 2026 because the project is still on Node.js 20
symptoms: Every new deployment errors while the project Node.js Version is still 20.x
Node.js 20 is no longer selectable in Project Settings
Existing deployments keep serving while every new deploy fails
cause: Vercel deprecated Node.js 20 for builds and functions on October 1, 2026, leaving 24.x (default) and 22.x. An engines.node value in package.json overrides the dashboard choice, so a pinned 20.x keeps failing after the setting is changed.
fix: Set engines.node to 24.x or 22.x and update the project setting, then redeploy. Use vercel project ls --update-required to find affected projects.
affected: Vercel projects on Node.js 20.x, new deployments from 2026-10-01
